tools.name: list_jobs
tools.label: List jobs
tools.description: Jobs with status, department, location and candidate counts.

tools.name: get_job
tools.label: Get a job
tools.description: One job in full: description, requirements, salary, location, team and its pipeline stages.

tools.name: list_pipeline
tools.label: Read a job's pipeline
tools.description: A job's pipeline: candidates per stage, with when they applied, ratings, overdue flags and upcoming interviews.

tools.name: list_talent_pools
tools.label: List talent pools
tools.description: Talent pools (candidate lists outside a specific job) with their candidate counts.

tools.name: search_candidates
tools.label: Find candidates
tools.description: Find candidates by name or email, optionally within one job.

tools.name: filter_candidates
tools.label: Filter candidates
tools.description: Search all candidates, across every job, by skills, experience, education, languages, tags, sources, rating and dates.

tools.name: get_candidate
tools.label: Get a candidate
tools.description: One candidate's profile: contact details, every job they're in with stage and status, tags, sources, experience and education, custom fields and screening answers.

tools.name: get_candidate_cv
tools.label: Read a candidate's CV
tools.description: The plain text of the candidate's CV and their typed cover letter, for reading or comparing candidates.

tools.name: create_candidate
tools.label: Add candidates
tools.description: Add a candidate, optionally straight into a job or talent pool.

tools.name: update_candidate
tools.label: Edit candidates
tools.description: Change a candidate's name, headline, emails or phone numbers.

tools.name: list_candidate_notes
tools.label: Read notes
tools.description: Notes the team wrote on a candidate, newest first, with author and replies.

tools.name: get_candidate_evaluations
tools.label: Read evaluations
tools.description: Interview scorecards and questionnaires for a candidate: each reviewer's rating, notes and answers, plus Recruitee's overall summary.

tools.name: get_candidate_activity
tools.label: Read a candidate's activity
tools.description: The candidate's timeline: applications, stage moves, emails, evaluations, notes and other events, newest first.

tools.name: list_candidate_emails
tools.label: List emails
tools.description: Email threads with a candidate in Recruitee's mailbox.

tools.name: get_email_thread
tools.label: Read an email thread
tools.description: One email thread with every message's sender, recipients, date and text.

tools.name: add_candidate_to_job
tools.label: Add candidates to jobs
tools.description: Put an existing candidate into a job's pipeline, or into a talent pool.

tools.name: move_candidate
tools.label: Move candidates between stages
tools.description: Move a candidate to another stage of a job.

tools.name: disqualify_candidate
tools.label: Disqualify candidates
tools.description: Disqualify (reject) a candidate in one job.

tools.name: requalify_candidate
tools.label: Requalify candidates
tools.description: Undo a disqualification: the candidate is back in the job's pipeline, in the same stage.

tools.name: add_note
tools.label: Add notes
tools.description: Add a note to a candidate's profile, visible to everyone on the team with access.

tools.name: tag_candidate
tools.label: Tag candidates
tools.description: Add tags to a candidate.

tools.name: untag_candidate
tools.label: Remove tags
tools.description: Remove tags from a candidate.

tools.name: list_interviews
tools.label: List interviews
tools.description: Scheduled interviews with candidate, job, time, place or video link, and interviewers.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.label: List tasks
tools.description: To-dos for the hiring team, soonest due first.

tools.name: create_task
tools.label: Create tasks
tools.description: Create a to-do for the hiring team, optionally about one candidate.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.label: Complete tasks
tools.description: Mark a task done, or reopen it.

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.label: List team members
tools.description: People on the Recruitee team with their role and whether they recruit or hire.

tools.name: list_reference_data
tools.label: Read tags, sources and departments
tools.description: The company's tags, candidate sources, departments, locations or disqualify reasons, with IDs for the other tools.
